title: The YAML header

steps.say: subtitle, author and date fill the title block. date: today is the render date, so it never goes stale.
format: html: holds the options for one output format. toc: true builds a contents list from the ## headings.
Look in the folder: next to report.html Quarto wrote report_files, with the chart picture, styles and scripts. E-mail the HTML alone and it arrives broken.
embed-resources: true packs everything into the HTML itself. One file that opens anywhere, even offline.

final:
---
title: "Unemployment in the regions"
subtitle: "Synthetic data, for training only"
author: "Labour statistics team"
date: today
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    embed-resources: true
---

Unemployment fell in most regions between 2022 and 2025.
This note shows the national trend and the latest rates.

## Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
rates <- read_csv("unemployment.csv")
glimpse(rates)
```

## Trend

```{r}
kingdom <- rates |> filter(region == "Kingdom")
ggplot(kingdom, aes(date, rate)) + geom_line()
```
